title: INDIA bloc MPs march to ECI headquarters against 'vote theft' and electoral roll revision
seoTitle: Delhi march against 'vote theft' and CEC

tea.why: Opposition MPs are protesting alleged 'vote theft' and irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
tea.want: Protesters demand action against alleged 'vote theft', address concerns over SIR, and removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
tea.changed: Oct 6: INDIA bloc MPs are expected to march from Parliament to the ECI headquarters in New Delhi.

summary: On October 6, 2026, INDIA bloc MPs planned a protest march from Parliament to the Election Commission of India (ECI) headquarters in New Delhi. The demonstration was organized by the INDIA bloc, a group of 19 opposition parties including the Congress, to protest alleged "vote theft" and irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. They also demanded the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. In response, Delhi Police significantly heightened security around the ECI office and Vijay Chowk, deploying approximately 4,000 personnel and setting up multiple barricades. Traffic advisories were issued, and police stated that no permission had been granted for the march.

updates.text: The protest call was issued after a meeting of 19 opposition parties.
Civil society groups began demonstrations demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
Delhi Police heightened security around the ECI headquarters and issued traffic advisories for the planned march.
Opposition MPs are scheduled to march from Parliament to the ECI headquarters at 11 am.
INDIA bloc leaders are expected to meet President Droupadi Murmu to raise concerns over the SIR exercise.
